subject.title: fix: avoid English audio prompt for non-English STT hints

question: Should this PR wait for live non-English STT or Telegram voice-note proof, or may maintainers override the proof gate based on source-level request-shape tests and reporter evidence?
rationale: The code path looks correct, but this external PR changes provider request defaults and currently has only tests/CI rather than after-fix real behavior proof from a live setup.

options.title: Require live STT proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live output, logs, a terminal screenshot, recording, or linked artifact showing a non-English transcription request after the patch with the language hint preserved and no implicit English prompt.

options.title: Override proof and accept risk
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the source-level proof and compatibility impact, then land the preferred candidate PR once exact-head checks are acceptable.

options.title: Pick another candidate PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99008 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99026 has stronger proof or a preferred shape, close this duplicate after preserving useful tests or discussion links.

recommendation.title: Require live STT proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live output, logs, a terminal screenshot, recording, or linked artifact showing a non-English transcription request after the patch with the language hint preserved and no implicit English prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the PR, added the latest narrowing refactor commit, and has substantial history in the media-understanding implementation path.
